chunks: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal narrated from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
“Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله granted the grandmother one-sixth, while Allah, Mighty and Majestic, did not prescribe anything for her.”

key_terms.أَطْعَمَ: granted or assigned as a share
key_terms.يَفْرِضِ: to prescribe or fix as an obligatory legal share
key_terms.ٱلْجَدَّةَ: the grandmother as an inheriting relative

ai.seo_question: What is the grandmother’s share in inheritance according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the grandmother's share of one-sixth in inheritance was granted by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, not through a specific Qur'anic allotment. It reflects a legal ruling in inheritance law and shows the authoritative role of the Prophetic sunnah in detailing shares not explicitly fixed in the Qur'an.
